angle.attack.description: An ambush in the ring, backstage or in the car park. Few words, lots of impact.
angle.attack.name: Attack

angle.confrontation.description: Rivals come face to face. Words are traded and it may not stay peaceful.
angle.confrontation.name: Confrontation

angle.contract-signing.description: A table, a contract and two people who do not like each other. It rarely ends with just a signature.
angle.contract-signing.name: Contract Signing

angle.interview.description: A backstage or ringside interviewer asks the questions and the talent answers.
angle.interview.name: Interview

angle.promo.description: Someone takes the microphone and talks to the crowd, an opponent or the camera.
angle.promo.name: Promo

angle.video-package.description: A pre-recorded piece that builds a rivalry or introduces someone new.
angle.video-package.name: Video Package

finish.cheating.name: Cheating finish
finish.cheating.summary: Feet on the ropes, a fistful of tights or a hidden object; the referee misses it.

finish.clean.name: Clean finish
finish.clean.summary: One side beats the other fair and square; nobody can argue with the result.

finish.controversial.name: Controversial finish
finish.controversial.summary: A missed kick-out or a fast count; the result stands but the crowd hates it.

finish.count-out.name: Count-out
finish.count-out.summary: One side stays outside too long and loses on the count; the title can't change hands.

finish.disqualification.name: Disqualification
finish.disqualification.summary: One side goes too far and the referee throws them out; the title can't change hands.

finish.double-count-out.name: Double count-out
finish.double-count-out.summary: Both sides brawl outside past the count and nobody wins.

finish.flash.name: Flash finish
finish.flash.summary: A sudden roll-up out of nowhere steals it before the match finds its stride.

finish.interference.name: Outside interference
finish.interference.summary: Someone from outside the match gets involved and swings it.

finish.no-contest.name: No contest
finish.no-contest.summary: The referee throws the match out; the title can't change hands.

finish.stalemate.name: Stalemate
finish.stalemate.summary: Neither side can put the other away and the referee calls it even.

match.battle-royal.description: A crowded ring where going over the top rope eliminates you. The last one left wins. Loose work, but crowds enjoy the chaos.
match.battle-royal.name: Battle Royal

match.endurance.description: A long one-on-one contest that rewards conditioning and patient mat work.
match.endurance.name: Endurance Match

match.four-way.description: Four workers, every one for themselves. The first fall ends it.
match.four-way.name: Four-Way

match.handicap.description: Two sides of different sizes: one worker against two or three, or two against three.
match.handicap.name: Handicap

match.singles.description: One against one. The plainest test of two workers, and the base every other type is measured against.
match.singles.name: Singles

match.sprint.description: A short, fast one-on-one bout with no time to settle in.
match.sprint.name: Sprint

match.tag-team.description: Two pairs, one worker from each side legal at a time, with tags to change over.
match.tag-team.name: Tag Team

match.trios.description: Two teams of three. Busy and fast, and a good way to get many people on a card.
match.trios.name: Six-Person Tag

match.triple-threat.description: Three workers, every one for themselves. The first fall ends it.
match.triple-threat.name: Three-Way

method.count-out.description: One side stays outside the ring past the referee's count.
method.count-out.name: Count-Out

method.disqualification.description: One side breaks the rules badly enough that the referee awards the match to the other.
method.disqualification.name: Disqualification

method.knockout.description: The opponent cannot answer the referee's count.
method.knockout.name: Knockout

method.pinfall.description: Shoulders held to the mat for a three count.
method.pinfall.name: Pinfall

method.referee-stoppage.description: The referee ends the match because one side cannot go on safely.
method.referee-stoppage.name: Referee Stoppage

method.submission.description: The opponent gives up to a hold.
method.submission.name: Submission

storylines.name: Test Storyline A
storylines.summary: A former champion wants the title back.
